description: Ekeaa Boroqatai wears a blue-grey floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, elbow-length sleeves and narrow gold geometric woven borders across the bodice, cuffs, central front and hem. Round shoulder clasps have hanging bead and tassel ornaments. A decorated matching belt has a round central medallion and long beaded hanging ornaments. A pale ivory fringed wrap with gold motifs and blue-grey edged borders rests around her forearms. A pale underdress shows through the lower front opening. Dark closed laced shoes are visible, and her gathered side hair is uncovered.
